title: AntiLag2025 V2 Optimize By ItzXery
features:
AntiLag2025 V2 Optimize is the upgraded and more stable version of the original AntiLag2025 script. This version has been fully optimized to deliver smoother performance, eliminate frame drops, and maintain visual quality across all devices—especially on low-end Android and PC systems.

It includes the signature pixel-style loading screen with animated percentage, rainbow text effects, ultra lighting enhancements, fast respawn system, and FPS boost integration. The GUI and all controls are temporarily locked during the loading phase to ensure proper initialization, then reactivated automatically or when “Skip Loading” is pressed.

AntiLag2025 V2 Optimize focuses on stability and consistent frame pacing, preventing screen stutter, lag spikes, and texture loading delays. It preserves original part materials (including special parts like “DamageBrick”) while applying lightweight optimizations to improve rendering speed. Shadows are intelligently managed to enhance visual clarity without impacting performance.

Main Features:
- Stable FPS Boost System (no frame skipping)
- Smooth loading animation with pixel text “Loading Script...”
- Skip Loading button for instant GUI activation
- Ultra Lighting and Shadow Optimizer
- Quick Respawn with R6/R15 ragdoll support
- Rainbow GUI and Pixel UI Design
- Material Optimizer with visual preservation
- Safe for all executors and universal across all games

AntiLag2025 V2 Optimize is designed to make your Roblox experience smoother, visually cleaner, and more responsive—without breaking gameplay or visual details.
